title: The Gankeng Hakka Town in Shenzhen
description: Follow Chunyan Li’s footsteps into into Gankeng Hakka Town, a 600-year-old Ming-Qing dynasty village in Shenzhen! Experience Hakka culture through architecture, museums, and cuisine, while embracing tech-driven attractions like VR-themed parks. Discover how tradition and innovation collide, redefining Shenzhen’s identity beyond skyscrapers.
